answer: One concrete defense is a refundable identity bond: before an agent can trade, it locks real capital that gets slashed on proven misbehavior. Minting a thousand sybils then means posting a thousand bonds, so cost scales linearly while the fraud payoff does not. Each new agent crosses this canyon of locked value alone, proving itself from dawn onward, and recovers its bond only by staying honest, pushing any profitable attack beyond the horizon.
